V554-SIG-001-NONTEMPORAL-EXACT.rule: A V553 object may be retained as contextual/provenance reference but may not count as semantic support for this invocation.

basis_contract.direct_intake_rule: Every consumer slot MUST be carried exactly or deterministically content-addressably dereferenceable. These are V554 consumer requirements, not new upstream ownership fields.
basis_contract.v553_intake_rule: SCR554 does not legislate V553's internal schema. M1 must prove that accepted SCR553 objects provide an exact projection satisfying these consumer slots without inferred source equivalence or label reconstruction.

complete_for_direct_v554_iff: The exact target use is STRUCTURAL_MEDIATION_INPUT under V554-SIG-001-NONTEMPORAL-EXACT.
The admitted proposition is already structurally complete for that invocation.
Every effective-time/interval/scope fact required by the invocation is exact and positively governed or the invocation explicitly requires no temporal discrimination beyond the admitted proposition.

The invocation requires no new V553-owned cross-time comparability, harmonization, temporal relation/delta, derived period/interval, sequence, persistence, drift, change, reversal, rupture, revision, temporal limit, noncomparability, or temporal support construction.
Every source/time/applicability relation material to the invocation has positive authority.
No applicable denial, noncomparability, required temporal gap/absence, unknown source relation, or unresolved authority blocks the invocation.
requires_v553_if_any: A rule-relevant V553 temporal semantic must be newly created for the exact use.
A cross-time or cross-source-time comparability/harmonization decision is required.
The exact use requires temporal point support not already complete as admitted structural meaning.
The exact use requires a temporal relation/delta or any derived interval/sequence/persistence/drift/change/reversal/rupture/revision semantic.
The exact use requires a V553-owned temporal limit, noncomparability, or gap/absence decision.
target_use_temporal_completeness.negative_law: An applicable temporal/source denial, noncomparability, gap/absence, or unknown relation may not be escaped by relabeling the invocation as direct/non-temporal. A different direct invocation is lawful only if independently identified by its own rule/signature/use and the negative is outside that invocation's governed scope.
target_use_temporal_completeness.metadata_law: Timestamp, wave label, historical-source membership, V553 artifact presence, or file availability alone does not require V553.

duplicate_equivalence.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON; object keys lexicographically sorted; semantically unordered ref arrays exact-deduplicated then bytewise sorted; semantically ordered arrays preserve governed order; no floats derived from scores participate.
duplicate_equivalence.why_basis_kind_is_excluded: Direct admission and a V553 restatement can only be detected as duplicate semantic support if route kind itself is not used to force inequality.
duplicate_equivalence.rule_relevant_temporal_normalization: Only temporal meaning required by the exact rule/use participates. Extra V553 material that is not required by the invocation does not make an otherwise duplicate basis independent. A genuinely new rule-required V553 temporal proposition changes the temporal fingerprint and is not equivalent to the direct proposition.
duplicate_equivalence.source_sensitivity: Source/universe/estimand/measure/weight and semantic authority distinctions are part of the key whenever they can change interpretation, support population, risk set, estimand, measurement meaning, or lawful use. Textual proposition equality cannot erase them.
duplicate_equivalence.equivalent_iff: All required equivalence-key components resolve exactly and are byte-identical after canonicalization.
duplicate_equivalence.not_equivalent_iff: At least one exactly resolved material equivalence-key component differs.
duplicate_equivalence.equivalence_unknown_iff: Any required material equivalence-key component is missing, ambiguous, mutable, hash-mismatched, not deterministically dereferenceable, or its materiality cannot be established under governing authority.
duplicate_equivalence.equivalence_unknown_effect: FAIL_CLOSED: emit no positive F1 for the affected collision set; preserve exact unresolved/conflict refs as K07-compatible nonpositive context where semantically meaningful; never guess equivalence or non-equivalence.
duplicate_equivalence.collision_probe_rule: If candidates overlap on the probe but full equivalence cannot be resolved, the overlapping candidate set is EQUIVALENCE_UNKNOWN and fails closed.

steps.name: INTEGRITY
steps.rule: Any schema/hash/reference/coherence failure yields INTEGRITY_FAILURE and no semantic F1/F2 fabrication.

steps.name: PRODUCER_PRECEDENCE
steps.rule: Honor exact producer-governed precedence internal to producer authority. V554 invents none.

steps.name: APPLICABLE_DENIAL_OR_HARD_NEGATIVE
steps.rule: Exact applicable target-use denial, temporal noncomparability, or required temporal gap/absence blocks F1. No direct fallback may evade it.

steps.name: STATIC_AUTHORITY_COMPLETENESS
steps.rule: Missing required static authority -> K06/nonassertable; unknown/conflicting required authority without governed precedence -> K07/nonassertable.

steps.name: TEMPORAL_COMPLETENESS_AND_SIGNATURE
steps.rule: Compute target-use temporal-completeness state and bind exact required basis_kind from signature mapping. UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED creates no positive route.

steps.name: DUPLICATE_EQUIVALENCE
steps.rule: Build source-sensitive equivalence groups. EQUIVALENCE_UNKNOWN fails the affected group closed.

steps.name: CANONICAL_BASIS_KIND
steps.rule: SIG-001 counts DIRECT_STRUCTURAL_EMPIRICAL_ADMISSION only. SIG-002/SIG-003 count V553_TEMPORAL_OBJECT only. Physically present nonrequired or no-op duplicate route objects are reference-only/rejected-duplicate provenance and contribute zero support.

steps.name: CONJUNCTIVE_F1
steps.rule: Only the one canonical semantic basis group satisfying the full rule may emit exactly one ELIGIBLE F1.

steps.name: DEFERRED_AND_INFORMATIONAL_F2
steps.rule: K01-K03 may coexist with F1; K04 is preserved. These states never change support count or basis precedence.

deterministic_basis_selection.same_kind_alias_reissue_rule: Multiple physical refs of the same basis_kind that are semantically equivalent count once. No physical winner is selected; the canonical semantic basis ID is derived from semantic identity, while every equivalent physical ref is retained in sorted provenance_alias_refs.
deterministic_basis_selection.distinct_basis_rule: Distinct exactly resolved material equivalence keys remain distinct candidates even when labels, proposition text, source name, geography, or time overlap. No netting, averaging, majority vote, score winner, or scalar collapse is allowed.

canonical_identity.canonical_json: Same canonical JSON rules as duplicate equivalence.

inputs: V554 applicability authority id/version/hash when F2 participates
all interpretation-critical negative/limit refs relevant to the decision
source/universe/estimand/measure/weight authority refs relevant to interpretation
producer schema/reference-contract authority versions required for deterministic interpretation

canonical_identity.F1_id: urn:rawlsing:v554:f1:sha256:SHA256(canonical_json({contract_version, equivalence_key, canonical_basis_semantic_id, rule_id, rule_version, rule_hash, signature_id, target_use, authority_bundle_fingerprint}))
canonical_identity.F1_law: F1 exists only in state ELIGIBLE. F1 ID is invariant to rejected duplicate-path presence and same-kind alias enumeration.
canonical_identity.F2_id: urn:rawlsing:v554:f2:sha256:SHA256(canonical_json({contract_version, candidate_semantic_key, f1_id_or_null, condition_kind_id, predicate_id, predicate_version, semantic_owner, resolution_owner, binding_producer, evaluator_owner, canonical_argument_envelope_fingerprint, target_use, producer_negative_or_requirement_refs}))
canonical_identity.F2_law: F2 uses exactly the nine ADP-001 kinds and CAN-001 predicate contracts. No tenth semantic kind is created by this close.
canonical_identity.B1_id: urn:rawlsing:v554:b1:sha256:SHA256(canonical_json({contract_version, candidate_semantic_key, f1_id_or_null, sorted_f2_ids, allowed_v555_structural_use, decision_state, producer_reference_spine_fingerprint}))
canonical_identity.B1_allowed_use: true iff a positive F1 exists and no applicable nonpositive hard block owns the exact target use; runtime-deferred K01-K03 and K04 informational constraint do not by themselves make B1 false.
canonical_identity.B1_nonpositive: Producer/rule-backed K05-K09 context may cross B1 with allowed_v555_structural_use=false. Integrity failure never becomes B1 semantic context.

states.INTEGRITY_FAILURE: presemantic; no F1; no fabricated F2/B1 semantic denial
states.EQUIVALENCE_UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED: no F1 for affected collision set; K07-compatible unresolved basis-equivalence context if semantically meaningful
states.ELIGIBLE: positive F1 only after all prior gates pass
states.VALID_EMPTY: coherent zero eligible candidates; no filler

negative_unknown_precedence.zero_law: Observed numeric zero is measurement, not missing authority, not denial, and not a basis-selection score.
negative_unknown_precedence.scope_law: A negative blocks only the exact proposition/use/rule scope it governs. V554 may neither broaden it nor ignore it by route downgrade.

determinism: Same contract/rule/signature versions plus same exact canonical semantic authority bundle produce identical basis selection, equivalence groups, F1/F2/B1 IDs and decision states.
Permutation of input rows, files, directories, or equivalent physical aliases changes neither semantic IDs nor support count.

Changed source universe, estimand, measure/weight authority, semantic authority version/hash, rule version/hash, or rule-relevant temporal semantics changes the relevant identity/fingerprint rather than silently reusing an old object.
No fuzzy rematching, latest fallback, network lookup, mutable alias repair, or default interpolation is allowed during replay.
replay.support_count_law: Each equivalence group contributes at most one semantic support basis to one proposition/use/rule invocation.

hostile_bypass_controls: Reject raw EmpiricalFact or DiscoveryResultReceipt at V554 semantic ingress.
Reject direct basis when the exact use requires new V553-owned temporal meaning.
Reject V553 basis as support for SIG-001 when it adds no rule-required temporal meaning.
Reject signature downgrade from temporal relational/point to direct to escape negative authority.
Reject legacy score/readiness/interpolation as authority or precedence.
Reject legacy seed IDs as canonical F1/F2/B1 identity.

M1_with_SCR553: SCR553 must expose exact immutable V553 object identity/content hash, originating StructuralEmpiricalAdmission lineage, rule-relevant TEMPORAL_* refs, applicable temporal negatives/limits, and source-relation/comparability authority refs without invented equivalence.
SCR554 consumes that projection without owning V553 internal schema.
M1 must prove temporal/source negatives cannot silently downgrade into direct positive basis and later-use temporal demand remains use-chain scoped.
M2_to_SCR555: SCR555 must consume exactly one canonical F1 per route by F1_id/B1_id.
Inherited F2 remains V554-owned and is transported by exact F2_id reference only.
No V555 reconstruction from StructuralEmpiricalAdmission, V553 labels, legacy seed IDs, or copied F2 prose.
M4_to_SCR5578: V557/V558 publication/repository must preserve canonical producer IDs/hashes, negative states, authority bundle and reference spine without reownership.
